description: A painterly, oil-style scene of a large red banner with a gold hammer and sickle and a red star, waving above a column of men in dark greatcoats and caps marching through falling snow. Behind them are red brick towers with white crenellations and spires, a striped onion dome at the far left, and a grey, stormy sky. No visible text, border or frame, and the painting runs edge to edge.
